hypothesis: Default locking is the in-memory provider, so the reservation lock and the cart completion lock only serialize within one server process. With two servers racing two carts that each need the single SOLO unit, both completions can pass the stock check and reserve it, overselling SOLO (no_oversell fails). The same gap may also allow duplicate completion of one cart across servers.

schema: oversold.scenario/v1
name: solo-two-servers-race
description: Two carts each hold the single SOLO unit and are completed at once from two servers.
target:
  engine: medusa
  version: 2.22.0
  servers: 2

  SOLO: 1

  alice:
    server: 1
    lines:

      qty: 1
  bob:

    lines:

      qty: 1
